starting.name: Prepared Clay
starting.ability: Once during each Materials Yard action you take, after gaining resources, you may form 1 vessel of any Shape by paying 1 more Clay than its Clay cost.
starting.abilityZh: 每次你执行泥柴场行动时一次，在取得资源后，你可以支付任意器型的正常泥费用加1泥，成型该器型1件。

starting.name: White Slip
starting.ability: Once during each Potter’s Wheel action you take, after forming, choose 1 vessel formed by that action. You may immediately give it White Glaze + Plain Decoration, paying the cost of Plain.
starting.abilityZh: 每次你执行陶车坊行动时一次，在成型后，选择该行动刚成型的 1 件器物。你可以立刻赋予其白釉 + 素面，并支付素面的费用。

starting.name: Rapid Drying
starting.ability: Once during each Glaze & Decoration action you take, after glazing, you may pay 1 Wood to load 1 ceramic from that action into an empty active Shared Kiln space or your empty Imperial Kiln, if gained.
starting.abilityZh: 每次你执行釉饰坊行动时一次，在施釉后，你可以支付 1 柴，将该行动处理的 1 件陶瓷装入空置的有效共窑窑位，或在已获得御窑时装入空置御窑。

starting.name: Kiln Tending
starting.ability: Once during each Kiln Yard action you take, after loading at least 1, you may gain 1 Clay or 1 Wood.
starting.abilityZh: 每次窑坊行动中至少装窑1件后，你可以获得1泥或1柴。

advanced.name: Large Throwing Wheel
advanced.ability: Once per round, during a Potter’s Wheel action in which you form at least 1 Vase or 1 Censer, reduce that action’s total Clay cost by 2, to a minimum of 0. This reduction stacks with the Shifu’s two-vessel discount.
advanced.abilityZh: 每轮一次，在陶车坊行动中形成至少1个瓶或香炉时，该行动的泥总费用减少2，最低为0。可与师傅优惠叠加。

advanced.name: Measuring Calipers
advanced.ability: Once per round, after you form a vessel, if you have another Shaped or Glazed vessel of a different Shape, gain 2 Coins.
advanced.abilityZh: 每轮一次，在你成型 1 件器物后，若你另有 1 件不同器型的已成型或已施釉器物，获得 2 铜钱。

advanced.name: Standardised Moulds
advanced.ability: Once per round, after you form a vessel, if you have another Shaped or Glazed vessel of the same Shape, gain 2 Coins.
advanced.abilityZh: 每轮一次，在你成型 1 件器物后，若你另有 1 件相同器型的已成型或已施釉器物，获得 2 铜钱。

advanced.name: Drying Frames
advanced.ability: Once per round after a Potter’s Wheel action, choose 1 Shaped vessel formed by that action. Immediately give it any Glaze and any Decoration, paying the Decoration’s cost.
advanced.abilityZh: 每轮一次，在一次陶车坊行动后，选择该行动刚成型的 1 件器物。立即赋予其任意釉与任意纹饰，并支付该纹饰的费用。

advanced.name: Reworking Table
advanced.ability: Once per round, during a Glaze & Decoration action, you may change the Shape of 1 Shaped vessel being glazed to any other Shape. Return its current Vessel card to its supply and take the new Shape card. No additional Clay is paid.
advanced.abilityZh: 每轮一次，在釉饰坊行动中，可将正在施釉的1件已成型器物改为任意其他器型，无需额外支付泥。

advanced.name: Glaze Palette
advanced.ability: Once per round, immediately before loading 1 of your Glazed ceramics, you may change its Glaze to any Glaze at no cost. Its Shape and Decoration do not change.
advanced.abilityZh: 每轮一次，装窑前，可免费将即将装窑的1件已施釉陶瓷改为任意釉色，器型与纹饰不变。适用于窑坊、催干和御烧优先。

advanced.name: Carving Knives
advanced.ability: Once per round, one Carved Decoration you apply costs 0 Coins.
advanced.abilityZh: 每轮一次，你施加的 1 个刻花纹饰费用为 0 铜钱。

advanced.name: Seal Stamps
advanced.ability: Once per round, one Impressed Decoration you apply costs 0 Coins.
advanced.abilityZh: 每轮一次，你施加的 1 个印花纹饰费用为 0 铜钱。

advanced.name: Crackle Slips
advanced.ability: Once per round, one Crackle Decoration you apply costs 0 Coins.
advanced.abilityZh: 每轮一次，你施加的 1 个开片纹饰费用为 0 铜钱。

advanced.name: Colour Samples
advanced.ability: When acquired: Immediately reserve 1 Main Order using the selection below, without placing another worker or gaining a Commission Market resource bonus. Once per round: During one reservation of a Commission Market action, use this selection instead of the normal reservation choice. Selection: Privately look at the top 3 Main Orders (or as many as remain). Reserve either 1 of those Orders or 1 face-up Main Order. Discard every looked-at Order you did not reserve; if you reserve from the display, slide later Orders left and refill the rightmost position immediately.
advanced.abilityZh: 获得时立即进行1次选择，不获得承接资源奖励。每轮一次，可用此选择替代瓷牙行行动中的1次承接。选择：私下查看牌堆顶3张主委托（不足则尽量查看），承接其中1张或1张公开委托，弃掉其余已查看委托。公开展示正常左移并补牌。

advanced.name: Protective Saggars
advanced.ability: Once per round, after Quality is assigned, you may spend 1 Wood to improve the Quality of 1 of your Flawed or Standard ceramics participating in this firing by one level: Flawed → Standard or Standard → Fine. This cannot create a Masterpiece.
advanced.abilityZh: 每轮一次，在决定品质后，支付 1 柴，使 1 件陶瓷提升一个品质等级：瑕品 → 良品，或良品 → 上品。不能因此成为臻品。

advanced.name: Fuel Ledger
advanced.ability: When choosing Bank or Stoke, you may secretly commit 1 additional Wood with your Contribution card. Reveal them together. If you do, your Contribution becomes −2 or +2.
advanced.abilityZh: 选择压火或添柴时，你可以把额外 1 柴秘密压在控火牌下，与控火牌同时公开。若如此做，该次控火修正改为 −2 或 +2。

advanced.name: Test Pieces
advanced.ability: Once per round, before Contributions are chosen, if you have at least 1 ceramic participating in this firing, you may pay 1 Wood to privately look at the top Fire card, then return it to the top of the deck.
advanced.abilityZh: 每轮一次，在选择控火牌前，若你至少有 1 件陶瓷参与本次烧成，你可以支付 1 柴，私下查看窑火牌堆顶端 1 张，然后将其放回牌库顶。

advanced.name: Second Firing
advanced.ability: Once per round, after Quality is assigned, choose 1 of your Flawed or Standard ceramics participating in this firing. Reveal 1 extra Fire card and recalculate that ceramic's Actual Heat and Quality using the same Base Heat and kiln position but the new Fire modifier. Previous Actual Heat adjustments do not carry over. The new Quality replaces the old, even if worse. Discard the extra Fire card after resolving it. Any unused once-per-round firing abilities may still be used at their normal timing.
advanced.abilityZh: 每轮一次，在决定品质后，选择 1 件瑕品或良品陶瓷。额外翻开 1 张窑火牌，使用相同基础火候及窑位、但采用新的窑火修正，重新计算该陶瓷的实际火候与品质。之前对实际火候的调整不会保留。新结果取代旧结果，即使更差也如此。结算后弃掉额外窑火牌。任何本轮尚未使用、且时机适用的每轮一次烧成能力，仍可在正常时机结算。

advanced.name: Kiln Furniture
advanced.ability: Once per round, when loading 1 ceramic into a High or Low Shared Kiln space, you may place this tile beneath that ceramic. Its zone modifier is 0 for this firing, even if the ceramic is later moved. Move the tile with the ceramic and return it to your workshop after firing.
advanced.abilityZh: 每轮一次，当你将 1 件陶瓷装入共窑高温区或低温区时，可以把本技艺牌放在该陶瓷下方。本次烧成中，该陶瓷的窑位修正视为 0，即使之后被移动也不变。若移动该陶瓷，技艺牌随之移动；烧成结束后收回。
